title: Bring deep SageMaker AI expertise to your coding agent with the AWS AI/ML skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Bring deep SageMaker AI expertise to your coding agent with the AWS AI/ML skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS
body_markdown:
Your coding agent can select, train, optimize and deploy models on Amazon SageMaker AI while working across the rest of your AWS environment in a single natural-language workflow. The AWS AI/ML skill is now a core skill in the[Agent Toolkit for AWS](https://github.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/tree/main) , so it works alongside the toolkit's other AWS skills like EC2, Bedrock, and more.


We released the new AWS AI/ML skill on the Agent Toolkit for AWS. The toolkit is now the single, supported integration point, replacing the previous AWS Labs skills and plugins, with a consistent and easy install and update path. The skill is also pre-installed into SageMaker Studio JupyterLab for use with Kiro or your coding agent of choice.


Moreover, we extended the SageMaker AI capability areas supported by skills.


-


[Inference optimization](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/new-agent-skill-amazon-sagemaker-optimized-generative-ai-inference-for-your-coding-agent/) : optimize deployed models for latency, throughput, and cost


-


[Model customization](https://builder.aws.com/content/3BRdZnv6dY63soyl4qn7FJMQdqd/agentic-model-customization-simplifying-fine-tuning-with-ai-guided-workflows-in-amazon-sagemaker-ai) : end-to-end guided fine-tuning workflows, from use case definition through training, evaluation and deployment


-


Serverful training for both traditional ML and generative AI


-


MLflow: experiment tracking and model lifecycle management


-


JumpStart model deployment and model recommendations: deploy pre-built JumpStart models and get guided recommendations on the right model for the use case


-


Processing jobs: data preparation and ETL on managed compute


The AWS AI/ML skill is available at no additional charge; you pay only for the AWS resources your agents use. To get started, install the skill from the[Agent Toolkit for AWS](https://github.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/tree/main) on GitHub, or use it pre-installed in SageMaker Studio JupyterLab. To learn more about[using a coding assistant with your SageMaker AI workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/studio-updated-jl-coding-assistant.html) , see the Amazon SageMaker AI documentation.
